name: flex
description: FLEX — Flexible Marketplace Platform (Telegram Mini App)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,ADMIN" -c "cyan,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flex/shared && npm run build -w @flex/server && npm run build -w @flex/client && npm run build -w @flex/admin
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/*/dist apps/*/node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules node_modules
